journey.name: wear quickpay over limit holds
journey.description:
With QuickPay on in the phone's settings, an invoice above the phone's QuickPay amount still opens the review and is paid only by the hold. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: as quickpay-skips-hold.xml: Phone settings on VSS with QuickPay on at $1 and 5×, see journeys/wear/README.md › Phone settings on VSS; Restored wallet on the watch with the same recovery phrase on the local ./spark stack with at least 12 000 sats, the app open on the Balance page and the loading ring stopped. 10 000 sats are above $1 while a bitcoin costs more than $10 000. README › Holding to pay has the hold gesture.

actions.action: Swipe left three times to the Settings page (README › Watch gestures)
Verify "WatchSettingsSyncTime" reads a time of at most 5 minutes ago; if it does not, tap "WatchSettingsSync" and wait 10 s
Swipe right three times to the Balance page and wait until "WatchHomeBalanceSecondary" reads a fiat value, for up to 1 minute
Run `../bitkit-docker/spark invoice 10000` and note the BOLT11 invoice it prints as <invoice>
Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:<invoice>" to.bitkit.dev`
Wait up to 10 s until "WatchSendHold" is listed
Wait 5 s and verify "WatchSendHold" is still listed and "WatchSendSent" is not: nothing was paid
Hold "WatchSendHold" for 2 s as in README › Holding to pay
Wait up to 15 s until "WatchSendSent" is listed
